description: pdf.split: one PDF into several, in a folder named after it.

notes.text: 'ranges': one file per part of `ranges`; 'every': `every` pages per file; 'pages': one file per page; 'odd_even': odd pages and even pages. Defaults to 'ranges' when `ranges` is given, else 'pages'.
Pages per file in 'every' mode; 1 when left out.
The files a split makes, as 1-based page lists with their name suffixes.
The same pages asked for twice would overwrite each other; the part number is unique.
